title: Schedule of Charges on the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts
content:
Each product in the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range sets its own annual fee, over-limit fee, late fee and returned payment fee, and its own yearly spend figure at or above which the annual fee is waived. All figures are US dollars.

| Product | Annual fee | Yearly spend at or above which the annual fee is waived | Over-limit fee | Late fee | Returned payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 0.00 | 0.00 | 39.00 | 35.00 | 29.00 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 30.00 | 29.00 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 99.00 | 6000.00 | 0.00 | 39.00 | 35.00 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 0.00 | 0.00 | 39.00 | 35.00 | 29.00 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 45.00 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 495.00 | 150000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 |

### Footnotes to the schedule

1. The annual fee is the charge for holding the account for a year. Two products in the range carry one: 99.00 on the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card and 495.00 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit. On the other four it stands at 0.00.
2. The waiver column is the yearly spend at or above which the annual fee is waived. Because the figure is read at or above, spend that reaches it exactly waives the fee: on the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card, yearly spend of 6000.00 reaches the waiver figure and spend of 5999.00 does not. On the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit the figure is 150000.00.
3. The over-limit fee is the charge where the balance goes past the limit. It stands at 39.00 on the Northbeam Store Card and the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account, at 35.00 on the Northbeam Store Card Plus, and at 0.00 on the other three products.
4. The late fee is the charge where the minimum payment misses its due day. It runs from 30.00 on the Northbeam Store Card Plus to 39.00 on the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card among the consumer products, and stands at 0.00 on both business products.
5. The returned payment fee is the charge where a payment is returned unpaid: 29.00 on three products, 35.00 on the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card, 45.00 on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and 75.00 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit. It is the one charge in this schedule that no product in the range sets at 0.00.
